scope: Converging Paths DOM read ordering and independent original-factory verification. Full 520-component acceptance remains open.

pixelFaultCorrectlyRejected.mutation: One rendered pixel changed independently of the model commands; exact RGBA comparison must reject it.

current.originalFactoryComparison: All current commands and RGBA channels match the immutable original factories exactly in this browser; captured states and clocks remain exact.

legacy.originalFactoryComparison: All current commands and RGBA channels match the immutable original factories exactly in this browser; captured states and clocks remain exact.

method: Each completed sample and compressed trace stays in its own run directory; no older run is overwritten.
Mesh runs for twelve seconds to include its original breath. Other scenes run for eight seconds. Paths completes one six-second replay; other scenes receive six Dock actions.
Fonts are prepared before mounting and CPU throttling. First trace Paint and two-frame readiness include mount and image decoding; route and font transfer are excluded.
The live page uses foundations.css. Frozen style.css is not a substitute for current Stage styles.
The sampler uses requestAnimationFrame without layout polling during the story. It records initialization and story long tasks and checks disposal.
Run sequentially without other heavy agent checks. Other applications are not controlled. Measurements do not automatically pass a timing gate.

mainThreadLayout.method: Count main-thread Layout and UpdateLayoutTree events enclosed by JavaScript FunctionCall spans. All traces and outliers retained; frame metrics count source callbacks, not independent presentation.

performance.frameRateMeans: Source requestAnimationFrame callback intervals; compositor presentation is not independently established.

retainedSlowDesktop.note: The slowdown is intermittent: a fresh unmodified baseline also reaches 59.94fps. Do not attribute every timing difference to this read-order change.

notes: Actual scroll top and extent are read before the complete original SVG/counter program writes. Full curve equations, native heads, copy, real fractional positions, six-second replay, input, holds and reduced fades remain unchanged.

Both fresh full CPU4 traces have 361 Layout and 361 UpdateLayoutTree events inside JavaScript before the change and zero after it. Layout still occurs in the normal rendering phase; this is not a claim that total layout time disappeared.

The initial full-Stage screenshot probe differed in three shared Dock glyph pixels by one channel. Component crops have 48 byte-identical PNG checkpoints and equal complete renderer states; frozen shared Stage/Dock sources are unchanged.

The model verifier executes complete original factories from immutable fixture source, driven independently by captured clocks and input API values. It never copies production model state. Current command streams and RGBA must match exactly, with no tolerance.

All historical fixture files, command captures and pixel hashes remain unchanged. Chromium 140 has zero historical differences; Chrome 158 records its 66 command-witness and 24 pixel-hash differences while matching the independent original exactly.
The before-renderer and deliberate one-pixel fault controls both fail as expected. All production images, SVG bytes, datasets, prompts, assets and unrelated component definitions are preserved.

All timing attempts, failed verification probes, historical comparisons and raw traces remain archived privately. Prepared-font Stage profiles exclude route/font transfer and do not complete cold-route, global performance, recipe or manual accessibility acceptance.
